versions.subject: rule: operation Wocao activity

selection:
    EventID: 4799
    GroupName: 'Administrators'
    ProcessName: '*\checkadmin.exe'
selection:

        - 'checkadmin.exe 127.0.0.1 -all'

        - 'reg query HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\*\PuTTY\Sessions\'
